evidenceInvariants: FINITEnumeric expected/tolerance are raw-bit equal to compiled requirement; all four doubles finite. NO_LOUDNESS uses raw+0 for expected/measured/minimum/tolerance with tagged nonnumeric meaning.

sourceFramesConsumed == required.sourceFrames, firstReadoutEndFrame/lastReadoutEndFrame/readoutCount equal literal protocol, resetCount==1 and eofReached==true; these are observed counters, not populated from expected metadata.

EOF_INTEGRATED: first=last=minEndFrame=maxEndFrame=F, readoutCount1; minimumLufs==measuredLufs by bits; completeGatingBlocks matches requirement; 0<=relativeGateBlocks<=absoluteGateBlocks<=completeGatingBlocks.
STEADY_EOF: first=last=minEndFrame=maxEndFrame=F,count1, minimumLufs==measuredLufs by bits; all three gating count fields exactly0 (not applicable).

MAXIMUM_FULL_WINDOWS: first=W,last=F,count=F-W+1; measuredLufs is max over all complete windows, minimumLufs aliases that same scalar value by bits, minEndFrame==maxEndFrame==first argmax inside[W,F]; three gating counts0. Zero-power windows still contribute to observed count but cannot replace a finite maximum.

CONSTANT_INTERVAL: first144001 for S/case9 or48001 for M/case12, lastF,countF-first+1; minimumLufs<=measuredLufs(max); minEndFrame/maxEndFrame are first argmin/argmax within interval; every required reading must be FINITE. Any missing/NO_LOUDNESS/nonfinite member forces failureReason INVALID_EVIDENCE rather than silently omitting it. Three gating counts0.

NO_LOUDNESS categorical PASSED only on ITU21/27 after complete EOF Integrated with completeGatingBlocks>0 and absoluteGateBlocks=relativeGateBlocks=0. Missing execution has no row, not an observed category. Numeric required absence FAILED.
Comparison numeric uses inclusive bounds e-.1/e+.1 with no epsilon or rounding; constant interval compares both extrema. Constructor numeric structure validity never means official PASSED.

Invalid input payload/order/identity/NaN can be rejected into finite FAILED report with zero offending evidence; never retain raw invalid doubles/unknown Strings/oversized lists. Failed legitimate finite readings may remain under caps. Bound hashes are complete4 or absent0, no fake SHA placeholders.
